lines.en: Looks like you finally decided to show my face.
Oh, Carly, I'm the real Carly.
And I, Carly, have nothing to hide.
God, she always uses the coolest words.
I don't want it, and yet I can't look away.
I have cold, hard evidence that proves
I am the one true Carly Shay.
To begin, I'll reveal something only the real Carly would know.
My first celebrity crush was Foghorn Leghorn.
I never had lustful yearnings for a Shapely cartoon rooster.
And to prove it, I'd like to share some of my fog-leg erotica.
It was a quiet night in the hen house.
